Chemistry 2008-II.question: Which one of the following is the softest?

Chemistry 2008-II.question: Which one of the following is used in the preparation of antiseptic solution?
Chemistry 2008-II.explanation: (b)  Iodine is a powerful antiseptic. It is used as a tincture of iodine which is 2-3% iodine solution in alcohol-water.

Chemistry 2008-II.question: Which one of the following is not a chemical change?
options: Crystallisation of table salt from sea water
Chemistry 2008-II.answer: Crystallisation of table salt from sea water
Chemistry 2008-II.explanation: (c)  A chemical change a new substance is formed. During crystallisation of table salt from sea water no new substance is formed hence, it is not a chemical change.

Chemistry 2008-II.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2008-II.question: Statement I :  Addition of water to an aqueous solution of HC1 decreases the pH.  Statement II : Addition of water suppresses the ionisation of HC1.
options: Both the statements are individually true and Statement II is the correct explanation of Statement I
Both the statements are individually true but Statement II is not the correct explanation of Statement I
Statement I is true, but Statement II is false
Statement I is false, but Statement II is true
Chemistry 2008-II.answer: Statement I is true, but Statement II is false
Chemistry 2008-II.explanation: (c)  Addition of water to an aqueous solution of HCl decreases the pH because on dilution the number of H+ ions (from water) increases. Now since [H+] = 10–pH \ As [H+] increases pH decreases.

Chemistry 2008-II.explanation: (d)  Fluorescent coating on the glass is the secondary source of light in a fluorescent lamp.
